steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds wonderful — glad you had a relaxing time with Maria!

Would you like help turning that into an email or message to someone? I can draft or send one now, save it as a draft, or help you compose a post. Here are three short sample emails you can use or edit — tell me which one to send (and to whom), or ask for changes.

1) Short note to friends
Subject: Quick update — countryside weekend
Body:
Hi all — I spent a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister, Maria. We explored nature trails, soaked up the fresh air, and it was exactly the reset we needed. I’ve got some photos I’ll share soon. Hope you’re doing well!
— [Your name]

2) To parents (a bit more detail)
Subject: Weekend getaway with Maria
Body:
Hi Mom & Dad — I went away for the weekend with Maria to the countryside. We walked several nature trails, enjoyed long, quiet afternoons, and it felt great to unplug. We’re both back and rested. I’ll bring some photos next time we visit!
Love, [Your name]

3) Thank-you note to Maria
Subject: Thanks for a great weekend
Body:
Thanks for the lovely weekend, Maria. I really enjoyed the trails and the fresh air — it was the perfect break. Let’s plan another trip soon!
Hugs, [Your name]

Which one would you like to use, who should I send it to, and do you want me to send it now or save a draft?
